summary: This note is a biographical entry on Omar Ali Saifuddien III, the 28th Sultan of Brunei. It gives his full name, birth and death dates, and his reign from 4 June 1950 until his voluntary abdication on 5 October 1967. It also notes his post-independence role as Minister of Defence and his honorific nicknames.
one_line: Biography of Omar Ali Saifuddien III, 28th Sultan of Brunei, who reigned 1950–1967 and was later Minister of Defence.
key_facts: Omar Ali Saifuddien III was the 28th Sultan of Brunei.
He ruled Brunei from 4 June 1950 until his voluntary abdication on 5 October 1967.
His full name is Sultan Haji Omar Ali Saifuddien Sa'adul Khairi Waddien ibni Almarhum Sultan Muhammad Jamalul Alam II, GCVO, KCMG.
He was born on 23 September 1914 and died on 7 September 1986.
His title is given as DYTM Paduka Seri Begawan Sultan Sir Muda Haji Omar Ali Saifuddien III.
After Brunei's independence, he served as the country's Minister of Defence.
He was known as "The Architect of Modern Brunei".
He was known as "The Royal Poet".
He was known as "The Father of Independence".
